adventure.name: The Beginner's Cave
adventure.description: The Beginner's Cave has been set up by the Warlord as a service to all Free Adventurers, giving them a chance to try their skills in a not-too-dangerous setting.
adventure.style_prompt_prefix: Eyvind Earle Sleeping Beauty 1959 style, geometric angular Gothic architecture, jewel-tone palette of deep purples and midnight blues with burnished gold accents, Byzantine and Persian miniature influence, architectural depth with layered planes, painterly backgrounds with light-defined detail, flat graphic characters with subtle shading, Celtic ornamental details
adventure.author: Donald Brown
adventure.intro: You stand at the entrance to a cave. A sign over the entrance reads "Beginners Only!" Your heart quickens as you grip your weapon. Whatever lies within, fame and fortune await the brave — or a quick death awaits the foolish.
adventure.full_description:
Let us all toast the Warlord for restocking the cave daily!

Only beginners are supposed to enter the cave (but any character can). Knight Marshall William Misslefire is on duty to prevent inexperienced adventurers from doing anything really foolish (like entering the cave with no weapon at all!).

To return to the Main Hall, just leave the cave (by getting to the cave entrance and moving north). Once you have done so, Sam Slicker, the local dealer for treasures and booty, will pay you in gold for any items that you have collected (with the price adjusted slightly depending upon your charisma).

CONVERSION NOTES:

This is the true and original Beginner's Cave and actually the first Classic Eamon adventure, written by Donald Brown nearly three decades ago. In an attempt to preserve the flavor of the Classic Eamon experience, very little new content was added upon conversion to Eamon Deluxe conversion. Just the standard Eamon Deluxe enhancements and the addition of a few embedded artifacts which were  already hinted at in the descriptions. Although designed as a simple outing for new characters, the Beginner's Cave captures the unique experience of Eamon very well and is, in many ways, one of the best adventures ever written for it.

items.name: TrollsFire
items.description: The Pirate was carrying a beautiful sword. Carved on the hilt, in intricate detail, is the sword's name, "TrollsFire".

items.name: jewels
items.description: There is a large pile of jewels here!

items.name: inscription
items.description: You see an inscription on the wall which reads, "You can type GET ALL to pick up everything in the room. This will usually not pick up dead bodies or immovable objects like doors and inscriptions."

items.name: inscription
items.description: An inscription on the wall reads, "The instructions often show commands in all caps for emphasis, but commands are not case sensitive."

items.name: inscription
items.description: Written on the wall are the words, "Most commands can be abbreviated. For example, AT DR is the same as ATTACK DRAGON, and DR PO is the same as DRINK POTION."

items.name: writing
items.description: You see some words chiseled into the wall: "To repeat the last command, just hit the Enter key again. To recall previous commands, use the up and down arrow keys."

items.name: inscription
items.description: There are some words written here: "Interesting items are sometimes hidden (embedded) within the description of the room. For example, try looking at the boat in the bay. You can also find secret doors by looking at unusual features in the room, like rough walls, cracks, bookshelves, etc."

items.name: writing
items.description: You see some words carved into the wall: "You may change weapons by using the READY command, e.g., READY SWORD. You may wear armor and shields using the WEAR command (e.g., WEAR CHAIN MAIL) and take them off with the REMOVE command."
